title: Resampling/Best-of-N Capability x Monitor Threshold: Many Tries Defeat One Gate

original_idea.body: Measure a monitor's per-attempt miss rate p, then empirically verify that the probability of at least one undetected success approaches 1 as N resamples grow per the 1-(1-p)^N prediction.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Quantifying how repeated attempts defeat a fixed-threshold monitor shows single-attempt evaluations overstate safety.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Measure per-attempt miss rate, verify 1-(1-p)^N; accessible API/eval work.

novelty.reasoning: Best-of-N evasion of monitors is documented in 2026 control work (also covered by gen-2716 here).

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Best-of-N monitor evasion is documented in recent control papers.
